verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched an OpenAPI document at https://resend.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing the "openapi" key), so a machine-readable API spec can be downloaded directly from Resend. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) support this, but they are not themselves an API spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation pointing users to the spec, and evidence of the spec's completeness or version coverage relative to the documented endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://resend.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
